messages.subject: change navbar selection interactively
parts:
Hi all,
On my shiny page I have a navbar with different selections. One were the user can import a dataset through different methods. From a URL or a file on the client computer as well as A GET request added to the URL i.e. ?url=<url>. A second feature draws plots. I was wondering whether it is possible to make it change selection in the navbar automatically to the plot feature when a data set was successfully loaded? So the user does not need to change the selection in the navbar but it would jump to the plotting feature automatically.

Any ideas?

Thanks in advance

Christoph

messages.author: e04bb64c7c0b4424
messages.subject: Re: change navbar selection interactively
parts:
I am not quite sure why you wouldnt put the data uploading information into a sidebar panel but I think you can do what you are asking. If I am not mistaken I believe you can set up your app like: 

shinyUI(
navbarPage("App Title",
  navbarMenu("More",
     tabPanel("DataSet"),
      tabPanel("Plot")
  )
)))

From your server you can create an event observer

observeEvent(input$data, {
   updateTabsetPanel(session, "More", selected = "Plot")
})
 
The link to the updateTabsetPanel library is here: http://shiny.rstudio.com/reference/shiny/latest/updateTabsetPanel.html

In this case I am assuming that input$data is the loaded data. The event observer would run every time there is a change to the input$data element. You may have to change it but I think it should be a good start. Hope this helps ! Sorry if it didn't. Good Luck!

Amber
